name: Kanban
description: Software-production tasks by status, from internal task files or Linear. Start builds from ready cards; move cards to change a task's status.

settings.label: Doing limit
settings.help: The Doing column turns amber when it holds more than this.

settings.label: Task source
settings.help: Where tasks come from. The project's config.json task_system unless you override it here.

settings.label: Linear team
settings.help: The Linear team key, used when the source is Linear and config.json's task_system names no project_ref.

body.query: query($team: String!, $after: String) { issues(first: 100, after: $after, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id identifier title priority url state { id name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
query($team: String!) { workflowStates(first: 100, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id name type position } } }
mutation($issue: String!, $state: String!) { issueUpdate(id: $issue, input: { stateId: $state }) { success } }
